title: kbs dep tree <id> from the dep help examples returns 'not found' for an existing issue
description:
Reproduction (kbs 0.32.0): kbs dep --help lists the example 'kanbus dep tree kanbus-child'. In a project with an existing issue (kbs list shows it, kbs show <id> works), kbs dep tree <id> prints 'not found' and exits non-zero. Same result with the issue id copied from kbs show.

Expected: print the dependency tree (or 'no dependencies') for the issue. Either implement the subcommand as documented or remove the example from the help.
Acceptance: the documented command works on an issue with and without dependencies; Gherkin scenario.
right_now_summary: `kbs dep tree` cannot find existing issues, so the documented dependency-tree command fails.
